title: Design principles for 3D thermoelectric materials in power generators
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03225C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Seong Eun Yang, Jungsoo Lee, Haiyang Li, Byungki Ryu, Jae Sung Son
We propose a universal theoretical framework for 3D thermoelectric leg design that integrates geometry, material properties, and boundary conditions. Experimental validation with printed (Bi,Sb)2Te3 demonstrates up to 466% efficiency improvement.
